title: Design system preview assets: stylesheets of a demo on another host read at its public address
steps: S1: Ask GET /api/design-system/preview-asset for a stylesheet of a demo row on host fleet01 (this server dev) whose <label>.fleet01-sites.tracy.site name throws and whose public address serves the file, with innerOf wired to siteReadOrigin.
S2: Ask the same door for a font and a stylesheet of a demo on this host, then for a picture, a page, an escape and an unknown demo.
expect: S1: 200 text/css with the file's bytes, only the public address fetched.
S2: 200 read on its container only; 400 for a picture, a page or an escape, 404 for an unknown demo, nothing fetched for them.
evidence: 14/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.site after PR #1356: every preview-asset request of the 24 Joomla demos on fleet01 answered 502 DEMO_UNREADABLE and the Add site preview showed an unstyled page; the same CSS at the demo's public address answered 200
fence: Door test in node with a fake fetch; the wiring in route.js is checked on cowork.tracy.site after deploy, not by this case
